6e1fb2a522cec6f1.description: Develop, prepare, and deliver Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) training programs for employees working in Oil & Gas and petrochemical facilities. Conduct safety training sessions, workshops, and awareness programs covering workplace hazards, emergency procedures, and occupational health and safety. Provide training on emergency response procedures, hazard identification, risk assessment, and accident prevention. Deliver safety training in accordance with applicable OSHA, NEBOSH, NSC, and company HSE standards. Educate employees on environmental protection, workplace health, and industrial safety requirements. Prepare training materials, presentations, assessments, and instructional resources. Conduct practical demonstrations and exercises to improve employees' understanding of safety and emergency procedures. Evaluate participants' understanding and training effectiveness through assessments and feedback. Maintain accurate training records, attendance sheets, and certification documentation. Coordinate with HSE teams to identify training needs and address safety knowledge gaps. Promote safety awareness and encourage compliance with occupational health, safety, and environmental procedures. Provide safety instruction and technical guidance in both Arabic and English. - Education: Local and Expat Candidates with Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Safety and Health, Environmental Studies, or a related field, OR an Associate Degree or two-year Diploma in Industrial Safety or Safety Training. Expat Candidates Without a Degree: High School Certificate or Vocational School Diploma in Industrial Safety or Safety Training. - Experience: Candidates with a Degree: Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas sector. Candidates Without a Degree: Minimum 11 years of relevant experience in the Oil & Gas sector. - Language Proficiency: Fluency in both spoken and written Arabic and English. Minimum IELTS score of 6.0 or equivalent TOEFL scores: Internet-Based (iBT): 60 Paper-Based (PBT): 498 Computer-Based (CBT): 171 - Preferred Technical Skills & Knowledge: Experience in Oil & Gas and petrochemical environments. Strong knowledge of occupational health, safety, and environmental procedures. Expertise in emergency response procedures and workplace safety practices. Understanding of sociology, occupational health, and environmental factors. Familiarity with environmental standards and industrial safety regulations. Strong training, presentation, and instructional delivery skills. Ability to communicate safety procedures effectively to employees at different organizational levels. Knowledge of hazard identification, risk assessment, and accident prevention. - Preferred Certifications: OSHA Safety Certification. NEBOSH Certification. National Safety Council (NSC) Certification.

6e4c644ac1cf554a.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo products are consumed over one billion times daily across more than 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo achieved over $79 billion in net revenue, driven by a diverse portfolio of beverages and convenient foods, including brands such as LAY’S ®️, DORITOS ®️, CHEETOS ®️, GATORADE ®️, PEPSI ®️, and QUAKER ®️. The company's vision is to be the global leader in beverages and convenient foods through PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation focused on sustainability and human capital to drive value and growth within planetary boundaries. Role Overview Pepsico is seeking a Sr. Merchandiser to join its sales team. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. The primary objective of this role is to enhance PepsiCo's on-shelf presence in all assigned outlets. The merchandiser will also be responsible for conducting in-store sampling and promotions as needed, ensuring adherence to planograms for both on-shelf and off-shelf displays. Key Responsibilities Visit specific OT outlets according to the daily journey plan provided by the supervisor. Merchandise SSFL products within OT stores across various access points, including shelves, stands, and floor displays. Place Point of Sale (POS) material next to SSFL displays where applicable. Ensure all access points are merchandised in accordance with approved planograms. Rotate products using the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) method and remove sub-standard products. Maintain clean and fresh stock of SSF products on the shelf at all times. Monitor and report competitive activities in the market. Report any deviations from agreed terms with assigned OT customers or outlets. Provide daily activity reports for the prior day to the supervisor. Participate in sampling and redemption campaigns when required. Maintain a professional personal appearance and behavior in line with the Frito Lay code of conduct. Reporting and Market Intelligence The Sr. Merchandiser is responsible for reporting any non-compliance with agreed arrangements to the pre-seller immediately. Additionally, the role requires supplying the pre-seller with the latest market information to identify and capitalize on selling opportunities. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Ability to adhere to planograms and merchandising guidelines. Strong observational and reporting skills for competitive activities and deviations. Professional demeanor and adherence to company code of conduct. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the sales team, operating in a dynamic environment that values collaboration and new ideas. Employees are integral to PepsiCo's culture, which fosters a diverse, equitable, and inclusive space.

6ea9612c6206f02f.description: About the Role DP World is seeking a Senior Officer Organizational Development to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for developing organizational structures, policies, and workforce planning frameworks. The position leads talent management initiatives, including succession planning and leadership development, ensuring alignment between HR strategies and business goals to build a high-performing workforce. Key Responsibilities in Organizational Development Develop and maintain HR policies, procedures, and internal controls across all HR functions to ensure full compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements. Regularly review and update HR policies and procedures to align with government regulations and evolving organizational needs. Develop and maintain accurate job descriptions based on international best practices, ensuring clarity in role responsibilities and alignment with current organizational goals. Conduct job evaluations using systematic methods, such as the Hay Guide Chart-Profile, to determine the relative value of roles within the organization. Develop and maintain workforce planning models, monitor monthly headcount against plans, and provide proactive recommendations to address variances or gaps. Execute internal promotions and transfers based on approved structures, qualifications, performance appraisals, and financial impact, ensuring updates are reflected in the HR system. Talent Management Initiatives Develop and implement short- and long-term workforce and succession plans for key positions, ensuring alignment with business strategy and annual updates. Oversee the execution of talent development initiatives, including career pathing and succession planning, ensuring compliance with best practices. Design and implement targeted development programs for key talent, high-potential employees, and future leaders to support long-term organizational growth and retention. Supervise the design and execution of programs aimed at retaining and developing high-performing employees and successors for critical roles. 6e3177fde6bbd87a.description: About Oivan Group Oivan Group is expanding its People Operations function within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. We are seeking a People Operations Specialist to join our team in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for an individual with 5-10 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The People Operations Specialist will serve as the operational backbone of the team, responsible for maintaining accurate employee data and records, ensuring compliance with Saudi government platforms, generating clear reports from data, and acting as a primary point of contact for employees. This role reports to the People Operations Manager and involves close collaboration with Government Relations, Finance, and line managers. Key Responsibilities Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential employee data and records as the single source of truth. Clean, validate, and reconcile data, performing regular data-quality checks to identify and correct errors. Administer HR records and systems, preparing structured data for reporting and HRIS migration. Develop and maintain HR reports and dashboards (headcount, turnover, cost, leave, and Saudisation) using advanced Excel. Transform raw data into clear, accurate management reports and automate recurring reports. Support workforce analysis and respond to ad-hoc data requests promptly. Process transactions accurately and on time on Saudi government platforms, including QIWA, MUDAD, GOSI, and Muqeem. Ensure compliance with Saudisation (Nitaqat), the Wage Protection System (WPS), and Iqama, visa, and work-permit requirements. Coordinate with Government Relations and vendors to ensure timely transactions and updated records. Administer onboarding, contracts, employee changes, leave, attendance, and offboarding in accordance with policy. Prepare letters, certificates, and documentation accurately, maintaining audit-ready records. Support payroll inputs and benefits administration with accurate, timely data. Apply applicable Saudi Labour Law and company policy correctly in daily operations. Act as a primary, approachable point of contact for employee queries, handled with empathy, discretion, and professionalism. Support employee-relations, grievance, and disciplinary cases with accurate documentation, escalating matters of judgment as appropriate. Handle personal, government-ID, and salary data under strict confidentiality and data-protection controls. Maintain accuracy and completeness across records, promptly flagging anomalies and risks. Key Performance Indicators (First 12 Months) Targets for each indicator will be agreed upon with the People Operations Manager after an initial baseline review. Employee master data maintained complete and accurate within agreed quality thresholds. Government platform transactions processed accurately and within statutory deadlines. Recurring HR reports delivered on time and error-free. Employee queries acknowledged and resolved within agreed service levels. At least one measurable data-quality or process improvement delivered. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in People Operations or a related HR function. Demonstrated dependability and attention to detail. Proficiency in advanced Excel for data analysis and reporting. Strong understanding of Saudi Labour Law and government platforms (QIWA, MUDAD, GOSI, Muqeem). Ability to handle confidential information with discretion. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6e1d13b991dce0ca.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a Discipline Lead - Horticulturist to oversee the planning, establishment, maintenance, and long-term health of landscapes, plants, trees, and green infrastructure within projects. This full-time role ensures that all horticultural activities align with client specifications, landscape designs, environmental standards, and quality requirements, while coordinating with landscape architects, contractors, and project teams. Key Responsibilities Oversee the planned and designed cultivation, establishment, and maintenance of plants, trees, shrubs, and ground cover by contractors, supported by the SSC. Monitor plant health and implement appropriate watering, fertilizing, pruning, and maintenance programs. Ensure compliance with project specifications and horticultural standards provided by the client and their landscape designer. Evaluate and monitor planting methods and technologies undertaken by contractors, ensuring adherence to methodology with the aid of the SSC. Review landscape drawings and specifications. Coordinate with project managers, landscape architects, and contractors. Promote sustainable landscaping and gardening practices. Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and best practices. Support awareness initiatives related to plant health and landscape management. Communicate horticultural recommendations to clients, project teams, and stakeholders. Soil and Irrigation Management Assess soil conditions through testing and analysis in conjunction with the landscape designer and SSC. Coordinate irrigation design requirements and ensure efficient water management practices meet client design needs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in horticulture or a related field. Demonstrated experience in overseeing landscape planning, establishment, and maintenance. Proficiency in reviewing landscape drawings and specifications. Experience in coordinating with various project stakeholders including landscape architects and contractors. Knowledge of sustainable landscaping practices and environmental regulations. Work Type This is a full-time position within SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering.

6e24c984d1cf303b.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع عماد ابراهيم الفت حلواني للمعجنات عن أمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقه في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإدارة المالية والتخطيط، مع التركيز على إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أمين الصندوق مسؤولية الإدارة الشاملة للتخطيط المالي للمؤسسة، بما في ذلك: إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل، لضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية. توقع المدفوعات النقدية والتنبؤ بالمشكلات المحتملة الناشئة عن محدودية التدفق النقدي. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال في العمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في وضع سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل وإدارة المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التشغيلية والتمويلية. تحليل وتحديد خيارات شروط التمويل لتتناسب مع الاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية، والسعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض حول شروطه. المهارات المطلوبة يجب أن يمتلك المرشح القدرة على إجراء تحليل السيولة وسعر الفائدة والعملة والمخاطر المرتبطة بذلك. كما يتطلب الدور مهارات تحليلية قوية في التخطيط المالي وإدارة المخاطر. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل بفعالية. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

6e8fa1d610300428.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking an Internal Auditor for Capital Projects to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves conducting internal audit assignments to assess the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal control processes. The Internal Auditor will perform audit testing, identify control gaps, and propose improvements to support compliance and operational effectiveness. Key Responsibilities Support the planning of assigned audit engagements in accordance with the approved internal audit plan. Review relevant policies, procedures, processes, reports, and supporting documentation. Develop an understanding of the audited area, its objectives, key risks, and existing controls. Prepare audit procedures, checklists, and information requests under guidance. Perform financial, operational, compliance, and process audits across assigned business areas. Conduct control testing, data analysis, document reviews, interviews, and process walkthroughs. Evaluate compliance with approved policies, procedures, delegated authorities, and applicable requirements. Assess the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of internal controls. Obtain sufficient and reliable evidence to support audit observations and conclusions. Maintain accurate, complete, and properly referenced audit working papers. Identify internal control weaknesses, compliance gaps, operational risks, and process inefficiencies. Analyze identified issues and support the determination of their causes, risks, and business impact. Discuss preliminary observations with process owners and obtain supporting clarification. Prepare clear audit observations and practical recommendations for review. Support the preparation of internal audit reports and presentations. Promptly escalate significant risks, suspected irregularities, or sensitive matters. Follow up with process owners on the implementation of agreed corrective actions. Review supporting evidence provided for the closure of audit findings. Maintain accurate records of open, overdue, and completed corrective actions. Report delays or inadequate corrective actions to the Senior Internal Auditor or Audit Manager. Professional Standards and Conduct Perform audit activities in accordance with the internal audit methodology and applicable professional standards. Maintain independence, objectivity, confidentiality, integrity, and professional conduct. Exercise due professional care and sound judgment throughout audit assignments. Maintain and develop the knowledge and skills required to perform assigned audit responsibilities effectively. General Accountabilities Obtain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve related problems and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in internal auditing, particularly within capital projects. The role requires a strong understanding of audit methodologies and professional standards. Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

6ea3be535b7d747a.description: About the Role Abdul Latif Jameel Company Limited is seeking a Control Room Operator to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires 1-3 years of experience and focuses on ensuring the operational integrity and effective monitoring of security systems within allocated facilities. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to ensure that all allocated facilities equipped with CCTV and FLIR systems are consistently connected to the Central Control Room (CCR) and maintain an operational functionality of at least 90%–95%. The role requires advanced knowledge in operating and monitoring CCTV/FLIR systems according to established guidelines and manuals, directly impacting the management of security associate attendance and ensuring full security capacity across all sites. Key Responsibilities Operate CCTV and FLIR systems in accordance with provided guidelines and manuals. Ensure effective communication and accessibility to all sites connected to the Control Room. Verify that all CCTV systems connected to the Control Room are fully operational. Identify and report all fire alarms and motion detection alerts generated by the CCTV system at ALJ facilities. Respond to emergencies as per the Company’s Emergency Policy and Procedures. Monitor security associate attendance and punctuality, ensuring all sites are manned and recording any incidents in the Occurrence Book (OB). Immediately inform the security in charge on duty if any security guard is not relieved or if a post is unoccupied. Notify the concerned manager of any incidents occurring at ALJ premises within their area of responsibility. Record all emergency activities with necessary details to facilitate comprehensive incident reporting. Ensure all gates are locked and keys are securely kept and maintained. Monitor the CCTV/FLIR system and report any abnormalities to the security senior supervisor. Conduct health checks on each shift to ensure system operation and report any faults to the CCR. Ensure timely deployment of security dogs and record any inconsistencies at applicable sites. Monitor contractors and visitors via CCTV and report any inconsistencies. Formally hand over the shift to the incoming duty operator, detailing all incidents and activities. Maintain control room equipment, including CCTV and NVRs, and report any faults for prompt action. Manage access to the Control Room, ensuring all guests and visitors obtain an access permit prior to their visit. Decision-Making Authority The job holder is authorized to grant access to the CCTV system for heads of departments, based on instructions provided by line managers. Qualifications and Experience 1-3 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated advanced knowledge in operating and monitoring CCTV/FLIR systems. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply for this full-time position in Riyadh.

6e0ec2d5907223ab.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن مؤسسة مصادر الانشاء للمقاولات عن حاجتها لـ مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في القنفذة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، وضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع والبرامج ومتابعة سير العمل فيها. وضع وتتبع موازنات المشاريع والبرامج وإجراءاتها التعاقدية، وتحديد تكاليفها ومصادر تمويلها. متابعة عمليات التنفيذ لضمان إنجاز المشاريع وتحقيق أهدافها وفقاً للجدول الزمني والميزانية المحددة. توجيه ومتابعة تقدير الموازنة المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة للتنفيذ، وضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد. تحديد مخاطر المشروع والخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها في الوقت والطريقة المناسبة. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة. إدارة عمليات التغيير بناءً على الخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء مراحل المشروع الرئيسية وعملية إغلاق المشروع. تقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه الرئيسية وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات المتعلقة. توثيق كافة الوثائق والنماذج والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على تحضير تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري. رفع التقارير المتعلقة لمختلف الأطراف المعنية في المشروع وللإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لمبادئ وعمليات إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. القدرة على وضع وتتبع الميزانيات وإدارة العقود. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم وحل المشكلات. القدرة على قيادة الفرق والتنسيق مع مختلف الأطراف المعنية. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير إدارة المشاريع ضمن فريق مؤسسة مصادر الانشاء للمقاولات في القنفذة، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع للإشراف المباشر على المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

6ef1a7470c61f29d.description: About CrowdStrike CrowdStrike is a global leader in cybersecurity, dedicated to protecting the people, processes, and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, the company's mission has been to stop breaches, leveraging the world's most advanced AI-native platform. CrowdStrike operates large-scale distributed systems, processing nearly 3 trillion events daily, serving customers across all industries. The Opportunity: Regional Sales Manager CrowdStrike is seeking a Regional Sales Manager to drive incremental revenue with new customers in Saudi Arabia. This full-time field sales role focuses on directly selling enterprise security software solutions across the company's product portfolio, primarily through flexible and scalable licensing models. The role involves planning, prospecting, qualification, and closing new business accounts, as well as developing post-close relationships during the initial months. Key Responsibilities Prospect, identify, qualify, and close new customer revenue within assigned accounts by building relationships with key decision-makers, utilizing flexible licensing models. Develop and execute comprehensive business plans for each account, identifying core customer requirements and mapping CrowdStrike's solutions to business needs. Coordinate with internal stakeholders during customer onboarding, product adoption, expansion, and eventual transition of accounts to Account Managers focused on expansion/renewal. Maintain timely and accurate documentation of customer contact and activity data within CRM/Marketing software. Ensure accurate forecasting, consistent quarterly revenue delivery, and implementation of agreed account and business plans. Promote CrowdStrike's products, maximize brand recognition, and publicize success stories. Provide customer feedback to internal stakeholders for product, systems, and process improvements. Perform work primarily in the field, away from home or company office locations. Sell to and interact with executive-level customer decision-makers, including C-level, typically within Enterprise or complex public sector accounts. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 8+ years of relevant professional cybersecurity experience. Expert-level experience in resolving complex issues creatively and effectively, applying professional concepts and company objectives. Deep industry knowledge and understanding of customer decision-making processes, including goals, strategies, and business objectives. Expert-level presentation, customer service, financial/business acumen, and negotiation skills across all levels of customer engagement. Comprehensive understanding of the business and technical contexts of key account opportunities. Proven ability to act as a driven, self-starter who demonstrates leadership within assigned accounts. Proficiency in consultative effectiveness and establishing trust with internal and external customers. Functional knowledge of sales methodologies, techniques, the sales lifecycle of security software solutions, software business value concepts, and CrowdStrike's products. Demonstrated experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and drive business outcomes. Education A BA/BS degree or equivalent educational background is preferred. Work Environment This role involves significant field-based work, requiring the incumbent to operate away from a home or company office location to fulfill the duties of the position. Collaboration with various internal teams, including Account Managers, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Marketing, as well as external Alliance and Channel Partners, is integral to the role.

6ef9d68a75fbf715.description: About the Role a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; } Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced Director - Commercial MEP to lead the commercial and cost management of major mechanical, electrical, plumbing and ICT packages for the MBS Stadium project. This is a key leadership role within one of Qiddiya’s landmark developments, with commercial responsibility for MEP and technology packages valued at approximately SAR 2.4 billion . With most packages already procured, the position will focus primarily on post-contract commercial management , including cost control, contract administration, change management, forecasting, claims and the commercial close-out of complex packages. 6ec4622fc6d45e25.description: Job description At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Driven by rapid healthcare shifts and evolving stakeholder needs, Roche is redefining its societal role through the Patient Journey Partner (PJP). Operating at the center of the organization, the PJP functions as an empowered local leader who collaborates directly with ecosystem stakeholders to co-create high-impact, patient-centric solutions. This functionally agnostic role deliberately eliminates traditional sales and commercial targets to focus entirely on delivering faster, better outcomes for patients and the broader health system. Your Responsibilities The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem. Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster. Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community. Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner. By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem. The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs. Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Who You Are University degree (Pharmacy or a relevant field). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus. Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with TAE's and organizations is required. Experience partnering with PAGs is highly desired. Experience leading Cross-functional team is required. Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams is highly desired. Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence. Deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling engagement at the specialist level. Neuroscience experience is preferred. Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions Robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research. Fluent in English and Arabic (spoken & written). Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

Identify opportunities to improve estimating accuracy, tendering efficiency, and bid success rates. Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. Professional Experience Minimum 18 years of experience in civil tendering and estimation. Minimum 15 years of professional experience in the Saudi Arabian market. Proven experience managing large-scale and technically complex tenders for reputable construction companies. Strong exposure to EPC tendering and civil works associated with infrastructure, building, power generation, water, defense, and oil & gas projects. Demonstrated experience leading tendering teams and managing the complete bid lifecycle. Monitor the plan performance and initiate action to strengthen results and take the corrective action accordingly. Provide periodic work progress reports. 6e74b03a7713b2ff.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فاد الخليجيه للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق شركة فاد الخليجيه للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تنفيذ مشاريع المقاولات بكفاءة واحترافية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور للتقديم.

6ee36fe2a98cbd56.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه تبراك نجد للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل في الرياض. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء ضمن فريق شركه تبراك نجد للمقاولات في الرياض، ويساهم في تنفيذ المشروعات الهندسية المتعلقة بأنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نشجع المرشحين المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على التقديم.
